key_facts: On Sep. 14, 2026, TaskUs sent Brendan Nforbi an offer of employment for Teammate, Team Lead QA, via Adobe Sign to his personal email (bnn.cdl@gmail.com), with onboarding tasks in WorkDay. The same day he signed the United States Background Consent Form consenting to release of background-screening information to TaskUs USA LLC for employment-eligibility determination, and the Non-Disclosure and Invention Assignment Agreement with TaskUs Holdings, Inc. A TaskUs welcome graphic ('You + Us = Ridiculously Good Journey') accompanied the packet. No background-check vendor is named in the packet, no report has been furnished, and no adverse action has occurred. WorkDay onboarding emails received Sep. 14, 2026 identify the requisition as R_2608_10812 'Uber AV Teammate (SJ: 09/23/2026)' (candidate C261051599; anticipated start Sep. 23, 2026): the 6:50 a.m. 'Review Your Offer Letter' email offers the 'Uber AV Teammate (SJ: 09/23/2026)' position; 8:28 a.m. and 8:32 a.m. task notifications cover the CIAA Questionnaire and Welcome Message for that requisition. Uber AV is the client campaign — the prospective hiring decision-maker whose vendor instructions (including any registry-based screening criteria) would flow through TaskUs. Background-check vendor identified Sep. 14, 2026 (per user): First Advantage is conducting the search.
note: Prospective Cluster 5 employment matter. The file ripens only if TaskUs runs the background check and takes adverse action on registry information. Watch items: vendor identity CONFIRMED — First Advantage (same vendor as Matters 25/26; the ICRAA/FCRA notice template is turnkey), ICRAA §1786.16 disclosure/authorization compliance, pre-adverse and adverse notice cadence, and whether any rescission letter cites registry or criminal-history content. Uber AV identified Sep. 14, 2026 as the client campaign via the WorkDay requisition; corporate parent is Uber Technologies, Inc. — a prospective defendant alongside TaskUs if a registry-based non-hire follows, since the campaign client sets the screening criteria TaskUs executes.
